selection_rule: Maximize dev context_hit, then hit3, then hit1; break ties by smaller context budget, fewer searches, then configuration name. Retrieval selection is provisional until real-agent dev review.

dense_base.hypothesis: Baseline: Day 6 B exact cosine; small context may omit long evidence.

bm25.hypothesis: Lexical terms preserve exact Python identifiers and operators.

hybrid.hypothesis: Improvement 1: reciprocal rank fusion combines semantic and lexical evidence.

hybrid_context.hypothesis: Improvement 2: larger context and optional second search recover omitted evidence at greater token cost.
